title: Azure SRE Copilot
summary: A self-hosted, read-only SRE agent that investigates Azure Monitor alerts with the GitHub Copilot SDK and publishes verified incident reports to GitHub.
description: Azure SRE Copilot accepts Azure Monitor alerts for Azure Container Apps, gathers bounded read-only diagnostics, and publishes an incident report to a trusted GitHub repository. It is designed to make evidence and uncertainty visible rather than to change Azure resources.

An Entra-authenticated receiver validates each alert against reviewed configuration and queues it durably on Service Bus. A worker revalidates the message, runs allowlisted diagnostics with row, byte, and time budgets, and hands the evidence to an isolated Copilot SDK session that can only use host-provided diagnostic tools.

The host validates and redacts the model's report, keeps gaps visible, and records publication intent before writing a GitHub issue. If a write is uncertain, it reconciles by marker instead of creating a duplicate. The service never remediates Azure resources and never closes issues.

The offline source, runtime-policy checks, publisher integration, Bicep validation, and in-process pipeline acceptance are implemented. Live tenant, Azure diagnostics, and GitHub publication remain gated on external setup.

metadata.status: Offline gates complete; live deployment pending
highlights: Read-only, allowlisted diagnostics with explicit budgets
Model isolated from Azure credentials and GitHub write tools
